title: Environment Duels: A Microcosm of LLM Co-Evolution
summary: Through a tangle of real-world interactions, from synthetic training pipelines to data shared on the open web, frontier LLMs absorb what their predecessors and competitors create. How well does each model play its role in this ecosystem, as a creator and as a solver? We introduce Environment Duels, a dynamic agentic benchmark that evaluates both capabilities on interactive environments. Each model writes environments, each with a privileged hint, aiming for tasks that capable solvers fail without the hint and pass with it. Across nine frontier LLMs, solving and authoring prove to be distinct skills: the strongest solvers are not the strongest authors, while smaller models learn more from how others played and write the hardest environments and the most useful hints. Beyond the scores, the pairwise interactions form a microcosm of how models affect one another. Head-to-head outcomes are transitive and so yield a stable ranking; independent authors converge on the same designs; and in a reinforcement-learning study with Qwen3.8-27B, the learner's hint lift on an author's environments tracks how much training on those environments improves it on held-out reasoning and agentic benchmarks, whether the environments are its own or another model's. Each of these patterns has a counterpart in how models shape one another outside the duel. By staging these interactions under controlled conditions, Environment Duels offers a window onto how LLMs teach, challenge and learn from one another. Code is available at https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels.
facts: 论文提出 Environment Duels，一个动态 agentic 基准，让模型在交互环境中同时扮演环境作者与求解者。每个模型编写带特权提示的环境，目标是让强求解器在无提示时失败、有提示时通过。在九个前沿 LLM 上评测，发现求解与创作是两种不同能力：最强求解者并非最强作者，较小模型从他人玩法中学到更多，并写出最难环境和最有用提示。成对交互结果具有传递性，可形成稳定排名；独立作者收敛到相同设计；在 Qwen3.8-27B 的强化学习研究中，学习者在某作者环境上的提示增益，能预测用这些环境训练后在其留出推理与 agentic 基准上的提升。代码见 https://github.com/LLM-Duels/EnvDuels。
analysis: 该工作把“模型互相生成训练环境”这一生态现象做成可控基准，核心洞见是创作与求解能力解耦，且环境质量可用提示增益量化。传递性排名与作者收敛现象为模型自博弈/共演化提供了可测量信号，提示增益与下游训练收益的相关性则给出环境筛选的代理指标。局限在于仅九个模型、单一 RL 案例，结论外推需谨慎。
technical_value: 提供可复现的 agentic 基准与代码，提出“提示增益”作为环境难度与信息量的度量，并验证其与 RL 训练迁移收益的相关性，对合成数据筛选、自博弈课程设计有直接参考价值。
impact: 可能影响 LLM 训练数据合成与自演化流水线的设计，推动把“环境作者能力”纳入模型评测维度。

title: The End of Consensus Research?
summary: Consensus is a fundamental problem in distributed computing and at the core of state machine replication (SMR). Despite decades of active human research, discovering practical low-latency solutions to the problem is still open, as it requires combining protocol knowledge, correctness reasoning, implementation, and experimental evaluation. We report on how AI helped us discover A-greement, a new consensus protocol for geo-replicated state machines that significantly outperforms state-of-the-art solutions. Averaged across six deployments with 5 or 9 replicas, A-greement reduces the mean latency of a geo-distributed key-value store over the fastest baseline by 12.2% and 33.3% on write-heavy and read-heavy workloads, respectively, and matches the fastest baseline on read-only workloads. A-greement combines lease-authorized local reads, direct client learning for leader-ordered writes, and a fast fixed-quorum per-key write path, selected according to network topology and workload. At the heart of our discovery lies AI-greement, an agent harness for the "autonomous" discovery, implementation, experimentation, and verification of candidate protocols. AI-greement integrates (1) a concept-oriented protocol knowledge base, (2) a modular implementation skeleton, and (3) a Lean-based verification framework with reusable safety definitions, reference specifications, and proofs. AI-greement is of independent interest: its Lean formalization uncovers several previously unreported vulnerabilities in existing consensus protocols, and it provides guidelines on how domain-specific harnesses can turn general-purpose coding agents into effective tools for (distributed) computing research. facts: 论文报告 AI 辅助发现新共识协议 A-greement，面向地理复制状态机，在 5 或 9 副本的六种部署上平均，写密集与读密集负载下相较最快基线分别降低平均延迟 12.2% 与 33.3%，只读负载持平。协议结合租约授权本地读、客户端直接获知领导者排序写、按网络拓扑与负载选择的快速固定法定人数逐键写路径。核心是 AI-greement agent harness，集成概念导向协议知识库、模块化实现骨架、基于 Lean 的验证框架（含可复用安全定义、参考规范与证明）。其 Lean 形式化发现现有共识协议若干未报告漏洞。作者强调人类共识专家在搜索前后仍不可或缺。
analysis: 这是 AI 在分布式系统理论研究中产生可验证新成果的少见案例，关键不在于让通用编码 agent 自由发挥，而在于领域专用 harness（知识库+实现骨架+形式化验证）把搜索约束在可证明空间内。Lean 形式化发现既有协议漏洞，说明验证框架本身有独立价值。性能提升幅度中等但方向明确，人类专家仍处环路中。
technical_value: 展示“领域 harness + 形式化验证”将通用编码 agent 转化为科研工具的方法论，Lean 规范与证明可复用，对协议设计与验证自动化有较高参考价值。
impact: 可能改变分布式系统与形式化方法领域的研究流程，推动更多领域构建专用 agent harness；同时提示 AI 科研产出需人类专家把关。

title: Quant-Arena: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Quantitative Trading Research
summary: Quantitative research is an iterative loop: a researcher proposes a market hypothesis, implements it as an executable signal, tests it on historical data, and decides what to keep. Existing benchmarks score formulas, code, or individual trading decisions, leaving open whether large language models (LLMs) can complete this loop and produce strategies that work beyond the research period. We introduce Quant-Arena, a benchmark and public leaderboard for end-to-end quantitative research on real A-share market data. A model constructs features and stock-scoring code, receives feedback only on 2022--2023, and freezes one strategy for assessment on the sealed year 2024. A cash-account evaluator applies trading constraints and costs, including market impact estimated from a simulated order book. Scores are dominated by realized excess return and complemented by signal quality and the diversity of features used by the strategy. We evaluate nine frontier models, among which GPT-6 Astra scores highest; yet no model beats the equal-weight market in 2024. Quant-Arena is open to submissions from any model or agent harness.
facts: 论文提出 Quant-Arena，面向真实 A 股数据的端到端量化研究基准与公开排行榜。模型构建特征与选股代码，仅获得 2022–2023 年反馈，冻结一个策略后在封存的 2024 年评估。现金账户评估器施加交易约束与成本，包括基于模拟订单簿估计的市场冲击。得分以已实现超额收益为主，辅以信号质量与特征多样性。评测九个前沿模型，GPT-6 Astra 得分最高，但无模型在 2024 年跑赢等权市场。排行榜开放任意模型或 agent harness 提交。
analysis: 该基准把量化研究闭环（假设—实现—回测—决策）作为评测对象，并用封存年份与交易成本防止过拟合，设计较严谨。结果显示前沿模型尚不能稳定产生超越等权基准的策略，说明端到端量化研究仍是高难度 agentic 任务。局限是仅 A 股、单一年份封存，结论受市场状态影响。
technical_value: 提供带市场冲击模拟与交易约束的端到端评估框架及公开排行榜，可作为金融 agent 的可复现测试床，并暴露模型在样本外泛化上的短板。
impact: 为金融 LLM agent 评测建立更贴近实盘的基准，短期影响量化研究自动化工具选型，长期或推动 agent 在真实市场约束下的可靠性研究。

title: Multimodal Embodied Agents: A Unified Capability-centric Perspective from Computer-Use to Robot-Use
summary: Multimodal agents (MMAs) sustain interaction through reasoning, memory, tools, and feedback, most visibly as computer-use agents, while robotic systems (RSs) couple sensing and actuation under physical dynamics. We define multimodal embodied agents (MMEAs) as goal-directed systems that couple multimodal task reasoning with physical action and revise decisions from the resulting feedback. This raises a central question: what changes when a multimodal agent moves from computer-use to robot-use? We introduce PAPAV, a unified capability-centric framework of five recurring functions: Perceive the current state, Anticipate action effects, Plan a feasible course, Act through an interface or body, and Verify the outcome. Defined by function rather than architecture, these capabilities let PAPAV identify what all three share and then compare MMEAs with MMAs and with RSs. Five physical constraints, from partial observability to unverifiable outcomes, leave fewer choices fixed in advance and less room to reverse errors. Across 64 benchmarks, explicit evaluation centers on Act; only 5 assess Anticipate and 3 assess Verify, leaving both largely hidden behind task success. These constraints also frame the open challenges we identify. PAPAV therefore provides a common basis for designing reliable physical agents and measuring progress across all five capabilities rather than task success alone.
facts: 论文定义多模态具身智能体（MMEA）为目标导向系统，将多模态任务推理与物理动作耦合，并根据反馈修正决策。提出 PAPAV 能力中心框架，含五项功能：感知状态、预期动作效果、规划可行路径、通过接口或身体行动、验证结果。按功能而非架构定义，用于比较 MMEA、多模态智能体（MMA）与机器人系统（RS）。指出五项物理约束（从部分可观测到结果不可验证）减少预先固定的选择与纠错空间。在 64 个基准中，显式评估集中在 Act，仅 5 个评估 Anticipate、3 个评估 Verify。
analysis: 该综述的价值在于用统一能力框架把 computer-use 与 robot-use 放在同一坐标系下比较，并量化指出现有基准严重偏重“行动”而忽视“预期”与“验证”。这解释了具身 agent 在物理约束下可靠性不足的评测根源。局限是框架偏概念性，未提供新实验数据。
technical_value: PAPAV 可作为具身 agent 设计与评测的检查清单，揭示 Anticipate/Verify 评测空白，对构建可靠物理 agent 的基准设计有指导意义。
impact: 可能推动具身智能评测从任务成功率转向分能力度量，影响机器人基础模型与 computer-use agent 的评估标准。

title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration
summary: Sequential decision-making under partial observability is difficult because agents must explore to infer hidden, task-relevant information before acting effectively. Learning such information-gathering behaviors tabula rasa via online reinforcement learning is sample-inefficient, whereas offline imitation averages expert actions across hidden states and fails to learn exploration. In this work, we propose ASTEROID, a simple and effective student--teacher supervised learning framework that can learn test-time exploration. Although a privileged expert never needs to explore, we demonstrate that a history-conditioned student can learn to do so when trained with on-policy contexts: the student first collects on-policy context under partial observability, and the privileged expert provides action labels conditioned on that context. By distilling expert actions directly conditioned on the student's on-policy history, the student learns to systematically resolve partial observability, i.e., search while uncertain and exploit once the hidden state is revealed. This enables efficient test-time exploration (similar to Bayesian posterior sampling) without incurring the impractical training-data costs of reinforcement learning. Across a diverse range of eleven different environments, including discrete exploration benchmarks, robotic manipulation, navigation, and Procgen environments, ASTEROID achieves ~2x higher returns under fixed exploration budgets, uses ~100x fewer interactions than RL baselines, and outperforms frontier models at exploration. Finally, our method transfers policies trained in simulation to vision-denied real-world robot manipulation, exhibiting efficient exploration and increasing success by +40% over standard distillation. facts: 论文提出 ASTEROID，一种学生—教师监督学习框架，用于学习测试时探索。特权专家无需探索，但历史条件化的学生在 on-policy 上下文中训练：学生先在部分可观测下收集 on-policy 上下文，特权专家基于该上下文给出动作标签。在十一个环境（离散探索基准、机器人操作、导航、Procgen）中，固定探索预算下回报约高 2 倍，交互次数比 RL 基线少约 100 倍，探索表现优于前沿模型。方法将仿真训练策略迁移到视觉受限的真实机器人操作，成功率较标准蒸馏提升 40%。
analysis: 核心思路是用特权专家在学生的 on-policy 历史上打标签，从而把“探索行为”蒸馏进学生，绕开 RL 的样本低效与离线模仿的隐状态平均问题。与贝叶斯后验采样类比合理。实验覆盖广、真实机器人迁移是亮点。局限是依赖特权专家与仿真环境，真实场景特权信息获取成本需评估。
technical_value: 提供简单有效的探索学习范式，交互效率提升两个数量级，且可迁移到真实机器人，对具身策略学习与仿真到现实有实用价值。
impact: 可能降低学习探索行为的训练成本，推动机器人操作与部分可观测决策任务的落地。
